svg.aria-label: Pass count on the ten DABstep gold tasks by agent version. v0, NVIDIA's prompt on Haiku 4.5, passed 4 of 10. v1, cycle one's rewrite, passed 8 of 10 but broke task 1871; five fixed against one broken is p 0.109 on a one-sided exact McNemar test, so it was held. v2, cycle two's rewrite, passed 9 of 10 with five fixed and none broken, p 0.031, and was promoted to champion. Every version is compared against v0, the champion throughout.
svg.title: 4 of 10 to 9 of 10 in two cycles; the first was held, the second promoted

g.title: gridlines at 5 and 10 passes; the axis is 0
v0 · 4 of 10 · NVIDIA's nine-line inference prompt on claude-haiku-4-5 with a 57-line helper · 1 of 3 easy, 3 of 7 hard · $0.754, 90 turns · the champion both cycles were measured against

v1 · 8 of 10 · cycle 1: one Sonnet session, 40 turns, 3.85 M input tokens, added four prompt rules and thirteen helper functions · fixed 49, 70, 1273, 1681, 1753 · broke 1871 · one-sided exact McNemar p 0.109 · held as challenger, never champion

v2 · 9 of 10 · cycle 2: 27 turns, 2.05 M input tokens, kept v1's helper, removed best_matching_fee, added fee_total_for_rule and total_fees_paid · the same five fixed, nothing broken · p 0.031 · promoted, champion · 2697 still fails
